waived.reason: Third pass on the same player report. 'localNPCHitCooldown = -1' was read as 'one hit, ever' when it means 'one hit per NPC, ever' — a bound on repeats, not on the pass — so 409 of the pool's 446 once-per-NPC projectiles were losing their pierce entirely in a crowd. The bound moved onto the immunity window, where it makes repeats zero and leaves the crowd terms alone; single-target scoring is identical by construction (bodies = 1). Net over all tiers: calamity top-3 +4 MRR 0.239 -> 0.241, ieor top-3 +2 recall@K +4 MRR 0.136 -> 0.137, vanilla MRR 0.276 -> 0.274. The cost is calamity top-8 -4 across four sections that each lost one, against vanilla Pre-Plantera melee and ranged multi-target each gaining recall@K and top-8: 17 section rows moved, both directions. The mechanical story is the reason it is kept — the rule was reading a fact that is not in the game — and guide agreement is the check, not the goal. The 13 rows carried over from the first two passes are unchanged.
